==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. A giant alien koi fish has crashed into the mountain side. (This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Elven Village that resembles huts of wood and white stone, as well as castles, and is located in a forest of tall pine trees.)

The giant koi recognizes and empowers Johnson. (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet.) (The giant koi revealed that Johnson was originally from space, which kind of makes sense when you think about it. Johnson wears a spacesuit all of the time. The Were-Shark invaders were from space. Maybe all Were-Fish are from space? Maybe that's why the Were-Fish Society existed in secret? This is such an interesting development that I hadn't really considered.)

Johnson turns into a giant and flies into space to save the Cosmic Sea. (The Cosmic Sea resembles a colorful ocean in space populated by giant fish and Were-Fish.)
